incident: Redis cache outage increases database load
symptoms: cache hit rate dropped to near zero
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A Redis cluster failover left several cache shards unavailable.
successful_steps: Confirmed Redis errors and cache miss increase
resolution: Redis shard unavailability caused a cache miss storm and increased database load. Restoring Redis reduced DB pressure.
postmortem: Increasing DB pool could have worsened DB saturation.
Application restarts did not restore Redis.
